# Proclus

*412 – 485 · Greek · [Neoplatonism](../movements/neoplatonism.md)*

Greek philosopher, head of the Neoplatonic school of Athens, who gave [Neoplatonism](../movements/neoplatonism.md) its most systematic form in the Elements of Theology and the Platonic Theology.
